# pondlog

> Place-aware nature data for developers.

## What is pondlog

Open-source nature data aggregation: 8 data sources, 7 MCP servers, CLI, and npm packages. 1,000-crop planting calendar with climate-aware scheduling and companion planting graph.

## Links

- GitHub: https://github.com/andrewschristison/pondlog
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/org/pondlog
- CropGraph API: https://api.cropgraph.com
- MCP Registry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io

## MCP Servers

npx @pondlog/mcp-inaturalist
npx @pondlog/mcp-ebird
npx @pondlog/mcp-npn
npx @pondlog/mcp-usgs
npx @pondlog/mcp-mushroomobserver
npx @pondlog/mcp-garden
npx @pondlog/mcp-pondlog
